title: ctr: preserve args after "-" in images export
body:
urfave/cli/v3 breaks out of its flag parsing loop when it encounters a "-" positional argument without appending the remaining arguments, causing "ctr images export - <image>" to drop all image references and flags following "-".

When <out> is "-", recover the un-truncated arguments from the parent "images" command lineage and re-parse the tail starting at "-" with a sentinel placeholder so trailing image references and flags are preserved.

This workaround can be removed after the bug is fixed upstream:

* https://github.com/urfave/cli/issues/2418
* https://github.com/urfave/cli/pull/2419

Assisted-by: Antigravity
